title: Fill with a Modbus TCP level transmitter
summary: The level arrives over Modbus TCP from a networked transmitter. Fill to 80 % and stop immediately if communication is lost.
objectives: Use values received over a network
Guard control decisions with a communication status
starterProgram:
PROGRAM Main
VAR_INPUT
    StartPB : BOOL; (* Start button S1 (normally open). *)
    StopPB : BOOL; (* Stop button S2 (normally closed). *)
    LevelHighHigh : BOOL; (* Independent high-high switch at 90 % (TRUE when wet). *)
    LevelPermille : INT; (* Level from Modbus holding register 0 (40001), 0..1000 = 0..100 %. *)
    LevelPercent : REAL; (* Level from holding registers 1-2 (40002-40003), IEEE 754 float, high word first. *)
    LevelCommOK : BOOL; (* TRUE while the Modbus scan of the transmitter succeeds. *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    InletValve : BOOL; (* Inlet valve solenoid XV-101. *)
    DrainPump : BOOL; (* Drain pump P-102. *)
END_VAR
VAR
    Filling : BOOL;
END_VAR

(* Fill to 80 % (LevelPermille 800) only while LevelCommOK is TRUE. *)

END_PROGRAM
instructions: Start fills the tank; InletValve closes at LevelPermille >= 800 (80 %).
Without communication (LevelCommOK FALSE) the valve must stay closed.
The independent high-high switch also closes the valve.
Look at the Network tab to see the Modbus requests and responses.
hints: LevelPermille comes from holding register 0 (classic notation 40001).
LevelCommOK is FALSE until the first good response arrives.

criteria.title: The valve closes at 80 %
criteria.onFail: InletValve stayed open after the networked level reached 80 %.

criteria.title: Filling requires valid communication
criteria.onFail: The valve was open while the transmitter was not communicating.
